resources.string: Ekagra ko background mein chalne dein
SAFAR ki battery restrictions hata dein taaki Android aapka study session beech mein band karne ki sambhavna kam ho. Kavach bhi app ki yahi setting use karta hai.

Android ke request mein Allow chunein. Battery settings khule to Unrestricted ya No restrictions chunein aur background activity allow karein. Phir SAFAR par lautein. Setting badalte waqt timer chalta rahega.
Battery settings nahi khul sakin. Android Settings → Apps → SAFAR → Battery kholein aur Unrestricted ya No restrictions chunein.
